Account snapshot: Cerulean builds real-time personalization and live-QA features for streaming+social products. They need Dedicated capacity with hard throughput guarantees and predictable cost per 1M tokens.

POC objectives and acceptance criteria:
- Throughput: sustain 1,200 concurrent lightweight chat sessions -> target 4,000 RPS of short prompts (avg 40 tokens) without queueing for 95% of requests.
- Latency SLOs: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 150ms for 40-token completions; tail p99 < 350ms.
- Soak: 7x24h step-up test ramping from 25% -> 100% sustained traffic for 72 hours; validate memory/KV cache stability and no degradation in p95.
- Cost predictability: estimate reserved GPU sizing to meet 99% of peak with burst buffer; target < $0.12 per 1k tokens (negotiable).
- Reliability: automatic fallback to smaller quantized variants on capacity pressure; must not exceed 2% failed requests during fallback windows.

Test plan details (what we ran / will run):
- Representative prompts: short chat (user intents for content recs), user-profile -> personalization embed lookups, reranking requests (top-20 candidates -> top-3), and a 512-token summarization batch used only for nightly ETL. Example prompts saved in Drive.
- Models: primary: Llama-3-70B-q4f16 (quantized) + fallback: Llama-3-13B-q4; embedding: small MPT-embedding.
- Hardware/placement: initial pool: 12 x A100-80GB equiv (reserved), with headroom for 4 more GPUs for burst. Discussing H100 upgrade in Q4.
- Load parameters: synthetic mix 60% short chat, 25% embeddings, 10% reranking, 5% long summaries. Token length distribution attached in drive.
- Metrics collected: latency histograms (p50,p90,p95,p99), GPU util, host CPU, memory, KV cache hit rate, queue depth, tokens/sec, error rate, cost per token.

Preliminary results (from synthetic & early soak runs):
- Sustained 2,800 RPS at 40-token avg -> p95 ~ 140ms, p99 spiked to 420ms under unexpected garbage-collection on one node (ticket INF-1423).
- KV-cache improved p95 by ~22% for repeated prefixes after caching enabled.
- Embedding throughput scaled linearly with batch size; 512-batch embedding runs hit expected throughput.
